description: This file defines classes and functions for managing registration of ATen to ONNX functions within the PyTorch framework, including a registry class, metadata class, and utility functions for handling ONNX operator registration and overload retrieval.

classes.name: OnnxDecompMeta
classes.description: A data class that wraps an ONNX script function with additional metadata such as target, signature, custom status, and opset version.

classes.name: ONNXRegistry
classes.description: A class that manages a registry of ONNX functions, supporting registration, retrieval, and cleanup based on opset versions.

methods.name: _get_overload
methods.description: Retrieves a torch operator overload based on a qualified name string.

methods.name: from_torchlib
methods.description: Creates an ONNXRegistry instance populated with torchlib's registered operations.

methods.name: _register
methods.description: Registers an OnnxDecompMeta to a target operator in the registry.

methods.name: register_op
methods.description: Registers a custom operator with an associated onnx-script function.

methods.name: get_decomps
methods.description: Returns a list of registered ONNX decompositions for a given operator.

methods.name: is_registered
methods.description: Checks if a given operator is registered in the registry.

methods.name: _cleanup_registry_based_on_opset_version
methods.description: Filters registry entries to keep only the highest opset version implementations up to the current target opset.
